dataset_label_source.note: label = set name + the count the figure stands on, at its stamp (the served wave's axis at the cut of 3 September 2026: 431 of wave 1, 1,693 of wave 2, 29 tasks outside both waves); the kept lists of today (the kept set at 22 Sep 13:24): 430 of wave 1, 1,674 of wave 2 of this axis still kept — a task that left the kept set after the cut stays in the fit as cut (the ruling of 8 Sep); the count is the cut's, the split by the waves' membership today (the wave-1 pin of 10 September 2026 and the wave-2 list with its parked members); Definitions' rule of 22 September 2026: one string written by the fit's writer, printed by every composer, never a count composed on a page from two sources

frame.scorer: unified results: passes/n per configuration x task (board results under plus_status; pool results §1b-valid), Definitions' unified frame
frame.estimators: local-logistic trend with shipped bands (rho/deff), binned medians (15 bins) with bootstrap bands and crossings, raw running median; average-chain crossings read off the trend and its band (first upward crossing)

bayes_fits.gates_note: flagged models are SERVED with the disclosure, never withheld; gates_summary.py is the single source
bayes_fits.served_not_drawn: Bayesian curves for 55 models exist for this dataset but were fitted on a different difficulty axis than this view uses; they draw when a fit set cut on this view's axis is served (local-logistic curves shown meanwhile)
bayes_fits.note: Bayesian curves for 55 models exist for this dataset but were fitted on a different difficulty axis than this view uses; they draw when a fit set cut on this view's axis is served

basis_truncation.disclosure_rule: the measured no-move range; the design rule applies to new cuts only
basis_truncation.rule: spec of 6 Sep (w): served fits with every arm's r at or below r_star carry no basis disclosure and are not re-fitted on this account; above r_star a neutral, direction-free disclosure until the set's re-fit lands; the design rule of 6 Sep (h) stays in force (M per rule) for new cuts

wave_1.label: wave 1 (430 tasks)

wave_1_plus_2.label: wave 1+2 (1,299 tasks)
wave_1_plus_2.composition: wave 1 + wave 2; never includes wave 2 parked
wave_1_plus_2.fit_population_note: fit_population 1,288 = fit_original 430 (the range explorer's matrix frame at its last build) + the wave 2 kept count 858 after the twin fold (22 Sep 2026: the kept frame the served fits stand on; until then this figure added the wave 2 members); a served fit states its own task count from its owner's stamp, never from this figure

wave_2_plus_parked.name: wave 2 and wave 2 parked
wave_2_plus_parked.composition: wave 2 + wave 2 parked (every new task); never includes the pilot
wave_2_plus_parked.label: wave 2 and wave 2 parked (1,762 tasks)
wave_2_plus_parked.template_rule: the label of record (13 Sep ruling): the set name with its count of record; a FIT that draws this set states its frame count BESIDE the label from the fit owner's stamp (fitting's serving stamp), never inside it; the 10 Sep frame-count template is superseded; a page naming the SET uses label (the membership count new_total)
wave_2_plus_parked.never_includes: the pilot; 'wave 2' alone never means this union

all_waves_plus_pilot.name: wave 1 + wave 2 + wave 2 parked + pilot
all_waves_plus_pilot.composition: wave 1 + wave 2 + wave 2 parked + the pilot's hundred
all_waves_plus_pilot.count_source: the fit owner's stamp (fitting's serving_golden_combined.json task count as cut) — never this file
all_waves_plus_pilot.figure_label_template: wave 1 + wave 2 + wave 2 parked (2,192 tasks) + the easy-tasks pilot (100 tasks)
all_waves_plus_pilot.template_rule: the label of record (13 Sep ruling): the waves' count of record in the label, the pilot named with its plain what and the hundred of record as its own count (ruling 07:51:54Z 13 Sep); the fit owner's frame as cut is stated beside the label from its stamp, never inside it (supersedes the 10 Sep frame-count template)

hundred_of_record_check.rule: the label carries the ruled 100; a file count that differs is a departure to surface, never a silent relabel

all_waves_plus_pilot.pilot_part: the pilot's hundred (100); the 72 surplus pilot tasks of ways 1 to 5 and the doers' way-6 tasks (20 population + 10 surplus) are not in this label unless the fit owner's stamp says so
all_waves_plus_pilot.never_without: the word 'pilot' — the pilot is a third named set outside every wave and never enters a wave count or fit by default
all_waves_plus_pilot.words_of_record: the owner's word of 2026-09-08, relayed by the router, interpreted in this block's sentence; the verbatim in the store's record

waves._basis: LABEL COUNT = the set as it appears on the approved surfaces, as changed only by the owner's rulings (the 9 Sep HumanEval/132 ruling moved wave 1 from 432 to its present count): each wave's label is its count field in this file (count_key names the field). wave 1 = the board's graded set with a valid label (original_kept; the label-excluded originals were never board tasks on the approved surfaces), wave 2 = the frozen focus membership after the twin fold (new_focused), wave 2 parked = new_parked, wave 1+2 = original_kept + new_focused. Qualifiers beside every wave: kept_count (tasks with a valid label) and members (every admitted task) — both computed here, never typed. Pages that do not draw their label from this file name their own basis in their notes: a fitted figure names the fit frame from fitting's served stamp (following at each re-cut); a census of all runs names members. Basis settled with pool-pages-lead on 2026-09-08 against the approved surfaces (RULINGS.md WAVE LABEL BASIS SETTLED); the kept-everywhere word of that evening is withdrawn (no ruling behind it); re-decided 2026-09-10 under cleanup F1a-24 (RULINGS.md COUNT OF RECORD BASIS): the fields are the single source, the prose carries no typed count. 'wave 2' never includes 'wave 2 parked'
waves._rule: official names in figures with the count in parentheses; old names understood as aliases; 'wave 2' never means 'wave 2 parked'; the pilot set is a separate named set outside every wave (see pilot); a fit over every wave plus the pilot is labelled 'wave 1 + wave 2 + wave 2 parked + pilot (N tasks)' with N from the fit owner's stamp (all_waves_plus_pilot)
waves._word_of_record: the owner's word of 2026-09-08, relayed by the router, interpreted in this block's sentence; the verbatim in the store's record

testbed_situations.name: testbed situations
testbed_situations.composition: a third-kind set apart; never part of any wave
testbed_situations.label: testbed situations (1,964 derisking-pilot rows: 1,021 pilot designs under review by ruling of 11 Sep + 945 golden-pilot rows marked to run on the golden models (about 20 tasks per shape, by ruling of 11 Sep); 8,169 probe design rows held (roles baseline 136 / control 1,172 / positive-control 2 / situation 6,859); none in the pool store)
testbed_situations.never_includes: any wave task; a situation is a new task id even when its parent is a wave-1 task

census_pinned.rule: the census stamp the unified store's cells were cut from at this build; the curves page's void check reads it against the word's history and the store's held list and held_stamp
